badge.elemental_bendings.note.barrier_fi: Let go of [%s] to fire the wall forward
badge.elemental_bendings.note.blood_rise: Hold [%s] to rise, [%s] to sink and [%s] to drift forward
badge.elemental_bendings.note.charge: Hold the last [%s] of Combustion Blast, then let go
badge.elemental_bendings.note.clone_burs: Use it again while looking at one of your clones to burst it
badge.elemental_bendings.note.drink: Hold [%s] while you do it to drink the blood yourself
badge.elemental_bendings.note.grapple_sw: Strafe with [%s] or [%s] to swing around the anchor, hold [%s] to boost and press [%s] to let go
badge.elemental_bendings.note.healing_wa: With a potion in your main hand, keep holding [%s] for healing water
badge.elemental_bendings.note.ice_lash: While it is coiled, press [%s] to lash out
badge.elemental_bendings.note.jet_again: After the jump, press [%s], then hold [%s] to start the jet again
badge.elemental_bendings.note.jet_steer: Hold [%s] to rise and [%s] to sink
badge.elemental_bendings.note.lash: While it is coiled, press [%s] to lash out
badge.elemental_bendings.note.launch: Hold [%s] while you do it to launch yourself
badge.elemental_bendings.note.lava_lift: While you hold it, press [%s] to throw it or [%s] to let it fall
badge.elemental_bendings.note.lift: While you hold it, press [%s] to throw it or [%s] to let it fall
badge.elemental_bendings.note.puppet: While you hold it, press [%s] to make it strike or [%s] to hurl it away
badge.elemental_bendings.note.redirect: Uses the Lightning Bolt combo: within four seconds after lightning strikes you or your Lightning Strike lands, it redirects that lightning instead of firing a normal bolt
badge.elemental_bendings.note.slam: Inside the golem, press [%s] to slam the ground around you
badge.elemental_bendings.note.steer: Keep holding [%s] to steer it, let go to call it back
badge.elemental_bendings.note.wall_run: Sprint into a wall to run up it, press [%s] to kick off
badge.elemental_bendings.when.at_plants: while looking at grass or plants
badge.elemental_bendings.when.blood_or_c: while holding blood or clotted blood
badge.elemental_bendings.when.molten: while looking at lava, magma or earth
badge.elemental_bendings.when.on_fluid: while standing on water or lava
layer.elemental_bendings.bending.missing: You have not chosen whether you can bend.
layer.elemental_bendings.bending.name: Bending
origin.elemental_bendings.airbender.desc: You bend the air around you. Slice with blades of wind, blast enemies away, leap again and again through the sky and ride a spinning ball of air over land and water. Master it and you can learn vacuumbending, soundbending or spiritual airbending in the Airbending Paths skill tree.
origin.elemental_bendings.airbender.name: Airbender
origin.elemental_bendings.earthbender.de: You bend earth and stone. Kick boulders out of the ground, lift and hurl them, raise pillars and walls, tunnel through hills and ride a column into the sky. Stand your ground. Master it and you can learn metalbending, lavabending or sandbending in the Earthbending Paths skill tree.
origin.elemental_bendings.firebender.des: You bend fire drawn from your own breath. Punch flame, sweep walls of fire across the ground, breathe fire, and rocket into the air on a jet of flame. Rain and water douse you. Master it and you can learn lightningbending, combustionbending, blue fire or dragon fire in the Firebending Paths skill tree.
origin.elemental_bendings.non_bender.des: Most people in the world cannot bend. You rely on your wits, your weapons and whatever your other origin gives you.
origin.elemental_bendings.waterbender.de: You bend water in all its forms: pull it from rivers, rain or a bucket, lash it like a whip, raise a shield around yourself, freeze it into spears and shards, and ride it across the sea. Push, pull and flow. Master it and you can learn bloodbending, plantbending or icebending in the Waterbending Paths skill tree.
power.elemental_bendings.airbender/air_b: Spin up a ball of air, sit on it and ride it wherever you look. It climbs over blocks and skims across water for as long as you hold the last key. Let go or hop off and it breaks apart.
power.elemental_bendings.airbender/air_j: Push off the air itself to leap again, up to four times before you land. While gliding with an elytra it throws you forward instead.
power.elemental_bendings.airbender/air_k: Kick a powerful gust that throws back everything in front of you and strips the leaves off trees.
power.elemental_bendings.airbender/air_n: You move with the wind. Your gusts put out fires they pass through, and a landing after an Air Jump is always cushioned. Defeating creatures earns mastery points for the Airbending Paths skill tree, where you can learn vacuumbending, soundbending or spiritual airbending.
power.elemental_bendings.airbender/air_s: Cut the air with a blade of wind that slices through everything in its path.
power.elemental_bendings.airbender/sound: Hum a soothing tune for as long as you hold the last key, up to fifteen seconds. Animals within sixteen blocks are drawn toward you and soothed, wolves, iron golems, bees and other defenders nearby turn on the hostile creatures around them, and animals close to you draw hostile creatures away from you.

Draw the sound out of the air around you for twelve seconds. You make no sound and set off no sculk, and creatures within eight blocks fall silent and lose track of whoever they were hunting unless they stand right next to them. Use the combo again to end it early.

Hum a tone too low to hear that scrambles the senses of every creature within seven blocks for six seconds. Disoriented players see the world sway, hear sounds that are not there and cannot aim or sprint properly, and disoriented creatures stumble around and lose track of what they were hunting.

Send out a pulse of sound and listen for the echo. Every creature within twenty four blocks glows through walls for eight seconds: hostile ones red, players white and the rest green. Until then you also hear every step, hit and footfall around you, and whatever makes a sound keeps glowing.

You bend the vibrations in the air, so you can hear and shape sound itself. Every soundbending skill turns one of your airbending moves into a sound technique or adds a new one, and Shattering Scream completes the path.

Scream so hard that the air itself shakes. The scream reaches sixteen blocks, hits half again as hard as Sonic Scream, slows what it hits and shatters glass, ice, lanterns, flower pots, amethyst and other fragile blocks in its path.
Clap your hands together hard enough to send a thunderclap through everything in front of you, throwing it far back.
Let out a scream focused into a beam of sound that hits everything in front of you up to ten blocks away and pushes it back.

Trap a growl in a bubble of air and throw it. When it bursts against a creature, the growl goes off right in its ears. Hostile creatures nearby turn on it and it lashes out at them, and a player it hits is disoriented for a few seconds.
power.elemental_bendings.airbender/spiri: While you meditate, leave your body behind and roam as a spirit for up to forty seconds. Your spirit flies like Flight, passes through blocks (sneak to sink through the floor), sees in the dark and cannot be hurt, but it cannot touch, break, use or attack anything. Your body keeps meditating where you left it. Use the combo again to return to it. You snap back at once if your body is hurt or you stray more than sixty four blocks from it. It needs thirty seconds to recover.

Bend the air around your whole body and fly for as long as you hold the last key, up to twelve seconds. You fly where you look: walk forward to fly forward, jump to rise, sneak to sink and sprint to rush. You never take fall damage while flying or when you land from it.
Your airbending draws on the spirit world. Each spiritual skill makes one of your airbending moves stronger or teaches you a new one, and Astral Projection completes the path.

Sit in the lotus position and float a hand's breadth off the ground for as long as you hold the last key, up to twenty seconds. While you meditate you heal, your hunger eases, harmful effects leave you and you sense every living creature within thirty two blocks through walls. You cannot move until you stand up.
Send an astral copy of yourself up to seven blocks ahead, straight through walls and floors, and step into it a moment later. It becomes your new body. The copy needs room to stand where it stops.
Your Air Kick carries spirit energy. It reaches sixteen blocks, throws harder, strips leaves and hurts what it throws.
Your Air Jump is lighter than air. You can leap six times before you land, and with an elytra it throws you farther.
Your Air Ball shimmers with spirit light, rolls faster and holds together half again as long.
Your Air Slice glows with spirit energy. It flies faster and farther, cuts through up to twenty creatures and hits forty percent harder.
power.elemental_bendings.airbender/vacuu: You have learned to take air away instead of pushing it. Every vacuumbending skill turns one of your airbending moves into a vacuum technique or adds a new one, and Suffocation completes the path.

Hold a square wall of pressurized air in front of you for as long as you keep the last key down, up to ten seconds. Arrows and other projectiles that pass through it lose most of their speed, and creatures that push through are slowed. Let go to fire the wall forward and shove everything in its path.
Draw the air around you into your hands and squeeze it tight, then let it go all at once. The blast hurts everything within five blocks and throws it away from you.

Push a wave of compressed air out in every direction that throws back everything within five blocks and snuffs out fires. For three seconds afterwards the pressure stays around you and shoves back anything that comes too close.

Pull the air out of the lungs of the creature you look at, up to sixteen blocks away, and hold it there for as long as you keep the last key down, up to five seconds. It cannot breathe, sprint, eat or drink, its air runs out and it takes damage that ignores armor, more the longer you hold. Taking a hit breaks your focus and lets it breathe again. Undead, golems and other creatures that do not breathe are immune. It needs fifteen seconds to recover.

Tear the air out of a point up to twenty two blocks ahead of you and let the pressure drag you to it, like a grapple with no rope. It works in mid-air too, three times before you land, and the landing never hurts. Sneak to let go early.

Open a pocket of low pressure where you look, up to fourteen blocks away. For three seconds it drags every creature and item within six blocks toward its center, then it collapses and flings whatever is left inside it into the air.
A vacuum under your feet holds you to walls. Sprint into a wall to run straight up it for about three seconds, and jump while running to kick off it. You recover when you land.
power.elemental_bendings.earthbender/ear: A column of earth rises under your feet and carries you up for as long as you hold the last key.

Rip a block of earth up to six blocks away out of the ground and kick it at your enemies. It flies level and curves into whoever is in front of you. Do it while sneaking to launch yourself off the ground instead.
Lift a block of earth and hold it in front of you for up to twelve seconds. It follows your aim, so line it up, then throw it where you look or let it fall.

Thrust a pillar out of earth up to twelve blocks away. Aimed at the ground or a one block step, it rises three blocks. Aimed at a wall, it shoots two blocks out of the side you can see, and aimed at a ceiling it hangs down. Anything in its way takes a hit and is carried to the tip of the pillar and thrown off the end, upward from the ground and away from the wall. Aim at your own feet to ride a pillar up.
Wherever you look at the ground, at least two blocks away and up to seven, a wall of earth three blocks high rises while you hold the last key. Sweep your view across the ground to build a wall.
Part the earth in front of you and tunnel through it for as long as you hold the last key. Only natural earth gives way, ores stay where they are, and nothing drops.
Send a wave of earth rolling along the ground that crashes through everything in front of you.
power.elemental_bendings.earthbender/lav: The ground at the spot you look at, up to sixteen blocks away, rumbles and erupts in a fountain of lava that hurls everyone standing there into the air and sets them alight, leaving a molten crater.

You heat earth until it melts and cool it again at will. The magma you make burns anyone who stands on it but never you, and your lava ignores neither stone nor metal: it melts through both. Lavabending skills replace your earth moves one at a time, and Magma Slam completes the path.

Scoop a ball of molten lava out of lava or magma up to six blocks away and hold it in front of you, following your aim. Throw it and it bursts on whatever it hits, setting it alight and splashing magma across the ground.

Melt a block of earth, magma or lava into a spinning disc and hurl it where you look. It cuts through every creature in its path, and through stone, earth and metal like butter, leaving a glowing slot behind.
Send a wave of lava rolling along the ground that burns through everything in front of you and leaves a trail of cooling magma.
Slam the ground and molten rock erupts around you in a ring that races outward, burning and hurling back everything within six blocks.

Melt the earth you look at, up to eight blocks away, into glowing magma and pools of lava for as long as you hold the last key. Look at magma or lava instead and you cool it into stone. Melted earth settles back after thirty seconds.
Raise a wall of molten rock five blocks wide and three high in front of you. It stops arrows and anything else thrown at you, burns whoever touches it, and cools into solid stone after four seconds.
power.elemental_bendings.earthbender/met: Scrap your chainmail, iron, gold or netherite helmet into six razor shards and fire them. They seek out the creatures in front of you, then fly back to your head and lock together into the helmet again. Until they do, your head is bare and the helmet gives you no armor.

You feel the specks of earth still trapped inside refined metal and bend the metal through them. Earth Kick and Earth Lift can rip up and hurl blocks of iron, gold, copper, raw ore, netherite and ancient debris as well as earth, and they hit harder. Your metal armor and weapons become part of your bending: every metalbending skill turns one more piece of your gear into a weapon. Pure metal answers you just as earth does, and Metal Chains completes the path.

Seize every scrap of metal within twelve blocks and pull it to you: dropped ingots, nuggets, raw ore and metal gear fly into your arms, and creatures wearing metal armor are dragged off their feet toward you.

With a chain in either hand you can fight with it or fly with it. Chain Lash ties the creature you look at, up to sixteen blocks away, to the nearest other creature. The chain slows them both, then shrinks and drags them together until they slam into each other and it snaps. With no one else close, it binds them to you and reels them in. Chain Grapple shoots a steel cable into whatever block or creature you look at, up to sixty four blocks away, and hauls you toward it. Strafe left or right to swing around the anchor, hold jump to boost and sneak to let go. You keep your speed when you let go, so you can fire the next cable in mid flight and keep swinging. Holding on tires your arms, three times as fast while you boost, and they recover once your feet are back on the ground.

Reshape your metal helmet into a pair of gauntlets. For twelve seconds your punches hit five points harder and throw your foes back, then the metal flows back to your head as a helmet. Your head is bare and the helmet gives no armor until it does.

Rip the metal out of your leggings and boots and drive it out as a pillar up to twelve blocks away, out of any solid surface, not only earth. Iron armor raises iron, gold raises gold, netherite raises netherite and chainmail raises bars. Whatever stands in its way is carried to the tip and thrown off. Your leggings and boots give no armor for three seconds while their metal reforms. Without metal leggings and boots it raises earth like Earth Pillar.

Rip the metal out of your leggings and boots and raise walls of it three blocks high wherever you look, on any solid ground, for as long as you hold the last key. The wall's metal matches your leggings, and your leggings and boots give no armor while you hold the walls up. Without metal leggings and boots it raises earth like Earth Shaping.

Break your metal chestplate into plates that whirl around you for as long as you hold the last key, up to twelve seconds. Arrows and other projectiles bounce off, blows land a third as hard and the spinning metal cuts whoever comes close. Your chest is bare while they spin, so the chestplate's own armor is gone until you let go and the plates fold back onto your chest.

Throw the iron, gold or netherite sword in your main hand and steer it with your aim while you hold the last key. It spins out to the spot you look at, up to twelve blocks away, cuts through every creature in its path and hangs there following your view. Let go and it flies back to your hand.
power.elemental_bendings.earthbender/neu: You bend natural earth and stone: dirt, sand, gravel, clay, stone, deepslate, terracotta, the stones of the Nether and the End, and the ores inside them, even under a layer of snow. Earth you tear up or raise settles back into place after thirty seconds, and kicks, waves and columns need solid footing. Defeating creatures earns mastery points for the Earthbending Paths skill tree, where you can learn metalbending, lavabending or sandbending.
power.elemental_bendings.earthbender/san: Loose sand answers you as readily as stone. Concrete powder and every kind of sandstone join the earth you can bend, so you can kick, lift, raise and send waves of them like any earth, and concrete powder hardens into concrete when you raise it. Sand you throw or roll at a creature bursts into a cloud that blinds it for a moment. Quicksand completes the path.

Turn the ground around you into quicksand for eight seconds. Every creature that stands in it, other than you, slowly sinks up to its waist and can barely move until the sand spits it back out six seconds later.

Crouch, press your palm to the ground and raise up to three warriors of packed sand around you. Hostile creatures nearby turn on the clones instead of you, and the clones fight back with their fists. Each one holds together for thirty seconds or until it takes a few hits, then crumbles back into sand, and a clone you strike yourself falls apart at once. You can keep four at a time. Use the combo again while looking at one of your clones to burst it into a cloud of sand that blinds and slows everything around it.

Whip the sand under your feet into a wave and ride it wherever you look for as long as you hold the last key, up to twenty seconds. It carries you up dunes and steps, and you never take fall damage while you surf. You can only surf on sand, red sand, sandstone and concrete powder.
power.elemental_bendings.firebender/blue: Your Fire Breath burns blue. It deals forty percent more damage and keeps what it sets alight burning three seconds longer.
Your Fire Circle burns blue. It deals forty percent more damage and keeps what it sets alight burning three seconds longer.
Your Fire Jump and Fire Jet burn blue. They deal forty percent more damage and keep what they set alight burning three seconds longer.
Your Fire Punch burns blue. It deals forty percent more damage and keeps what it sets alight burning three seconds longer.
Your Fire Wall burns blue. It deals forty percent more damage and keeps what it sets alight burning three seconds longer.

Spin up a tornado of blue fire where you look, up to ten blocks away. It stays where it forms for ten seconds and burns everything that comes close, and every few moments it lashes out at the nearest creature and drags it in. It needs fifteen seconds to gather again.
power.elemental_bendings.firebender/comb: Set off a controlled blast behind you and ride it the way you look, or down at your feet to launch straight up when you look at the ground. Twice before you land, and you never take fall damage after it.

Gather more and more chi behind your third eye before a Combustion Blast, then let go to fire. A full charge, two seconds, fires a blast twice as strong with a far wider crater. If anything hurts you while you charge, the blast misfires and goes off in your face, as hard as you had charged it.
Fire one heavy blast. Where it lands it explodes and throws out five burning embers that bounce away and go off one after another.
Fire four quick, smaller blasts one after another.
Focus your third eye and fire a beam that explodes where it lands.

Fire a blast that sticks to whatever it hits, the ground or a creature, and glows there for a moment and a half before it goes off. It has time to build, so it explodes much harder than a Combustion Blast.
Set off a blast all around you that throws everything back and leaves you unhurt.

You have opened your third eye. All the chi in your body gathers behind the tattoo on your forehead and leaves it as a beam of fire so hot it explodes on whatever it touches. Every blast tears a crater in the earth that fills back in after thirty seconds, and a blast that goes off close to you hurts you too. Your third eye is delicate: every hit to your head strains it, and while it is strained your blasts can misfire and explode in your face. A hit to the head while you gather a blast sets it off at once. The strain fades after a while.
Blast the ground at your feet into a thick cloud of smoke. Everyone close to you is blinded and slowed while you leap back and run, faster for a few seconds.
power.elemental_bendings.firebender/drag: Your Fire Breath shimmers with every color of the dragons' flame. It deals forty percent more damage and keeps what it sets alight burning three seconds longer.
Your Fire Circle shimmers with every color of the dragons' flame. It deals forty percent more damage and keeps what it sets alight burning three seconds longer.
Your Fire Jump and Fire Jet shimmer with every color of the dragons' flame. They deal forty percent more damage and keep what they set alight burning three seconds longer.
Your Fire Punch shimmers with every color of the dragons' flame. It deals forty percent more damage and keeps what it sets alight burning three seconds longer.
Your Fire Wall shimmers with every color of the dragons' flame. It deals forty percent more damage and keeps what it sets alight burning three seconds longer.

Spin up a vortex of rainbow dragon fire where you look, up to ten blocks away, with a red and a blue dragon coiling up through it. It stays where it forms for ten seconds and burns everything that comes close, and every few moments it lashes out at the nearest creature and drags it in. It needs fifteen seconds to gather again.
power.elemental_bendings.firebender/fire: Breathe a stream of fire for as long as you keep holding the last key, up to about seven seconds.
Spin and throw a ring of flame out around you.

Blast yourself upward in mid-air, once before you land. Keep holding the last key and a jet of fire takes over, so you hover for as long as you hold it. With an elytra the jet drives you forward instead, and landing after a Fire Jump never hurts.
Punch a short burst of flame that sets whatever it touches alight.
Sweep a line of fire along the ground in front of you.
power.elemental_bendings.firebender/inne: Your fire comes from your breath and the sun. Rain, water and bubble columns douse every fire move, and your fire burns a quarter hotter while the sun is up. Defeating creatures earns mastery points for the Firebending Paths skill tree, where you can learn lightningbending, combustionbending, blue fire or dragon fire.
power.elemental_bendings.firebender/ligh: Throw lightning at a creature up to 32 blocks away. It leaps from that creature to the next one close by, up to four more times, a little weaker with every leap.

Vanish in a flash and reappear where you look, up to twelve blocks away: on the ground you aim at, or just in front of the wall. Looking steeply down sends you straight ahead instead. You leave a crackling afterimage behind and run faster for a few seconds.

You separate the energy inside you into yin and yang and let it crash back together as lightning. Lightning is not fire, so rain cannot douse it, and creatures standing in water or rain take half again as much. It still grows stronger under the sun. Lightningbending skills replace your fire moves one at a time, and Lightning Storm completes the path.
Circle your arms to gather lightning, then thrust it from your fingertips at whatever you look at, up to 40 blocks away. It still finds a creature when your aim is slightly off.

Guide lightning in through the fingertips of one hand, down to your stomach and out of the other, away from your heart. For four seconds after your Lightning Strike lands, Lightning Bolt redirects that lightning instead: no wind-up, nearly twice the damage and a bolt that knocks targets back. Lightning that strikes you hurts a quarter as much and opens the same window.

Lightning rains down all around you for six and a half seconds and seeks out the creatures nearby. Every strike feeds your redirection, so Lightning Bolt can throw the storm's lightning back out the whole time. The storm needs half a minute to gather again.
Pour out a crackling stream of lightning up to 14 blocks long for as long as you keep holding the last key, up to about seven seconds.
Raise your arm and call lightning down from the sky onto the spot you look at, up to 48 blocks away.
Clap your hands and throw a cone of lightning out in front of you that throws back everything it hits.
power.elemental_bendings.waterbender/blo: Hurl the blood as a heavy ball that bursts on whatever it hits.
Blood Blast

Bend the blood in your own body and lift yourself off the ground for as long as you hold the last key. Hold jump to rise, sneak to sink and walk forward to drift. Your grip on your own blood slips the whole time: as it weakens you start to sink, and when it fails you drop. It holds longest under a full moon, and once you stop your blood needs five seconds to settle before you can rise again.
Blood Levitation

Take hold of the creature you look at and work it like a puppet. It hangs in front of you and follows your aim while you hold the last key, and it cannot strike back. You can make it lash out at everything around it or hurl it away. A bloodbender cannot ride the waves, so this replaces Water Glide.
Blood Puppetry
Coil the blood into a whip and lash out with it. Every creature the lash cuts gives you back some health. Let go of the held key to gather the blood back up.
Blood Whip
Clot the blood you hold into a dark, hard mass. Do it again to thin it back into blood.
Clot and Thin
Rake the clotted blood apart into a spray of hard shards.
Clot Shards
Throw the clotted blood as a piercing spear that leaves its victims withering.
Clot Spear
Tear blood out of every living creature within six blocks, wounding each a little, and hold it as a ball.
Draw Blood

You bend the blood inside living creatures. At night your waterbending turns to bloodbending, and the full moon doubles its strength. Undead and constructs have no blood to bend. Psychic Bloodbending lets you bloodbend at any hour.
Bloodbending
Seize the blood of every creature in front of you and lift them off the ground. They hang helpless in the air until you let go or the blood runs out, then drop.
Levitation
You no longer need the moon. Bloodbending answers you at any hour, so your waterbending is gone for good, and the full moon still doubles your strength.
Psychic Bloodbending
Pour the blood you hold into the creature you look at and heal it, or drink it to heal yourself.
Transfusion
power.elemental_bendings.waterbender/fre: Freeze the water you hold into ice. Do it again to thaw the ice back into water.
power.elemental_bendings.waterbender/ice: Shatter the ice into a spray of shards. Packed ice shatters into shards that hit half again as hard.
Ice Shards
Throw a piercing spear of ice that freezes and slows what it hits. Thrown from packed ice it hits half again as hard.
Ice Spear

Freeze the crushed ice into solid ice, then press it again into packed ice. Ice Spear and Ice Shards thrown from packed ice hit half again as hard and freeze for longer. Do it once more to loosen the packed ice back into crushed ice.
Deep Freeze

Draw water from a source within five blocks, a bucket or a bottle, and freeze it into a mass of crushed ice as it reaches your hands. Your water moves can throw it, freezing it compresses it into a solid block of ice, and with a potion in your main hand you still bend healing water.
Draw Ice
Hurl the crushed ice forward as a jagged block of ice that shatters on impact, freezing and slowing whatever it hits.
Ice Blast

Whip water from a source nearby around the creature you look at, up to sixteen blocks away, and freeze it solid. It is encased in ice for five seconds and cannot move. A player can punch the ice to break free sooner, and every blow it takes from outside cracks it too.
Ice Prison
Freeze a dome of thick ice around yourself for as long as you hold the last key. It stops arrows and fire, blows land a quarter as hard, and whoever strikes it is frozen in place for a moment.
Ice Shield
Your shoes freeze over whenever you sprint, so you skate across any ground as if it were ice, faster than you could run and gliding through the turns, with frost spraying from your heels.
Ice Skating
Coil the crushed ice around you as a whip of jagged ice and lash out with it. Every lash freezes and slows what it cuts. Let go of the held key to gather the ice back up.
Ice Whip

You freeze water the instant you bend it, so it always comes out as ice. Every icebending skill turns one of your water moves into ice that hits harder and freezes what it touches. Water Glide and healing water stay as they are. Ice Prison completes the path.
Icebending
power.elemental_bendings.waterbender/pic: Draw water up and hold it for fifteen seconds. Hold a potion bottle in your main hand and keep the last key held to bend healing water instead, which mends you and whoever you point it at.
power.elemental_bendings.waterbender/pla: Thorned brambles burst out of every patch of grass, moss, leaves and flowers around the spot you look at, up to sixteen blocks away, spreading out ring by ring. For ten seconds they cut and badly slow every creature that walks through them, then they sink back into the ground. They never hurt you. Under a full moon the thorns cut twice as deep. The plants need fifteen seconds before they rise for you again.
Bramble Field
Press the sap down into thick mud. Do it again to thin the mud back into sap.
Condense

You bend the water inside living plants. Plantbending replaces your waterbending, so you draw sap from leaves and grass instead of water from rivers. Your bending still grows stronger at night and under a full moon.
Plantbending
Drive the sap into a storm of razor leaves that slice through everything in front of you.
Leaf Storm
Heave the mud in a heavy arc. It hits much harder than water, slows and blinds.
Mud Shot
Fling the mud in a wide spray that slows and blinds whatever it hits.
Mud Splatter

Pull the plants around you into a towering golem and fight from inside it for thirty seconds. The golem is huge, heavily armored and punches very hard, but it is slow. Do the combo again to step out early.
Plant Golem

Call up the plants under the surface and let them carry you. Kelp, roots and leaves knot into a raft beneath your feet and race you across the water wherever you look, for as long as you hold the last key. Over lava the crimson and warped roots of the Nether carry you instead and keep the heat off you. You never take fall damage while you ride. This replaces Water Glide.
Root Glide
Hide a coil of vines in the ground. The first creature to step on it is bound for a few seconds. You can keep three snares set at once, and each lasts a minute.
Snare Trap
Burst the pollen out of every flower and the spores out of every mushroom within ten blocks. Creatures standing near them are dazed: sick, slow, half blind and weak.
Spore Cloud
Vines burst from the ground in front of you and bind every creature they catch. They cannot move or jump, and the thorns cut them for as long as you hold the last key.
Vine Snare
Grow the sap into a thorned vine coiled around you and lash out with it. The lash drags what it hits toward you and slows it. Let go of the held key to draw the sap back.
Vine Whip
Pull the water out of every plant within four blocks. Leaves fall, flowers and grass vanish and the ground turns to dirt for thirty seconds, and you hold the water as sap.
Wither
power.elemental_bendings.waterbender/pus: You bend water you can reach: water, ice, snow or rain within five blocks, a water bucket (three uses before it runs dry) or a potion bottle. Your waterbending is a quarter stronger at night and twice as strong under a full moon. Defeating creatures earns mastery points for the Waterbending Paths skill tree, where you can learn bloodbending, plantbending or icebending.
power.elemental_bendings.waterbender/wat: Hurl the water forward in a crashing jet that knocks back and puts out fire.
Ride a rushing wave across the surface wherever you look, for as long as you hold the last key.
Wrap yourself in a bubble of water that stops arrows and fire for as long as you hold the last key. You can barely move inside it.
Coil the water around you like a whip and lash out with it. Let go of the held key to gather the water back up.
skill.elemental_bendings.airbender.sound: Hum a tune that draws animals to you and rallies defenders.
Silence everything around you and slip past hunting creatures.
Bend the vibrations in the air. Sonic Scream replaces Air Slice, and more soundbending skills add new sound moves.
Scramble the senses of everything around you.
See every creature around you through walls with a pulse of sound.
Learn every other soundbending skill first. Shattering Scream replaces Sonic Scream, and you take on the soundbending stances and emblem.
Sonic Clap replaces Air Kick: a thunderclap that throws foes far back.
Throw a trapped growl that turns hostile creatures on its target.
skill.elemental_bendings.airbender.spiri: Learn every other spiritual skill first. Leave your body while you meditate, and take on the spiritual airbending stances and emblem.
Draw on the spirit world. Your Air Slice becomes Spirit Slice, and more spiritual skills strengthen your other air moves or teach new ones.
Bend the air around you and fly for a short time.
Float in the lotus position to heal and sense the creatures around you.
Send an astral copy through walls and step into it.
Your Air Kick reaches farther, throws harder and hurts.
Leap six times before you land.
Your Air Ball rolls faster and lasts longer.
skill.elemental_bendings.airbender.vacuu: Take air away instead of pushing it. Learn Pressure Burst, and more vacuumbending skills replace your other air moves.
Hold a wall of pressurized air that slows projectiles, then fire it forward.
Pressure Wave replaces Air Kick: a ring of compressed air that keeps foes at bay.
Learn every other vacuumbending skill first. Pull the air out of a creature's lungs, and take on the vacuumbending stances and emblem.
Vacuum Pull replaces Air Jump: drag yourself to where you look.
Vacuum Vortex replaces Air Slice: a pocket of low pressure that pulls foes in.
Sprint up walls on a vacuum under your feet.
skill.elemental_bendings.earthbender.lav: Melt earth into magma and cool it again. Melt replaces Earth Tunnel, and more lavabending skills replace your other earth moves.
Eruption replaces Earth Pillar: make the ground erupt with lava.
Lava Ball replaces Earth Lift: hold a ball of lava and throw it.
Lava Disc replaces Earth Kick: a spinning disc that cuts through stone and metal.
Lava Wave replaces Earth Wave: a rolling wave of lava.
Learn every other lavabending skill first. A ring of molten rock erupts around you, and you take on the lavabending stances and emblem.
Molten Wall replaces Earth Shaping: a wall of molten rock that cools to stone.
skill.elemental_bendings.earthbender.met: Bend the earth inside refined metal. Earth Kick and Earth Lift can hurl metal blocks, and more skills turn your metal gear into weapons.
Scrap your metal helmet into seeking shards that return to your head.
Pull loose metal and armored creatures toward you.
Learn every other metalbending skill first. Chain two creatures together and drag them into each other, swing through the air on a steel cable, and take on the metalbending stances and emblem.
Turn your metal helmet into gauntlets that make your punches hit harder.
Metal Pillar replaces Earth Pillar: pillars of metal out of any surface.
Metal Wall replaces Earth Shaping: walls of metal from your leggings and boots.
Break your chestplate into whirling plates that guard you.
Throw your metal sword, steer it with your aim and call it back.
skill.elemental_bendings.earthbender.san: Bend concrete powder and every kind of sandstone with all your earth moves, and blind foes with the sand you throw.
Learn Sand Surfing and Sand Clones first. Turn the ground around you into quicksand, and take on the sandbending stances and emblem.
Raise warriors of packed sand that draw your enemies' attacks and fight beside you.
Ride a wave of sand across deserts and dunes.
skill.elemental_bendings.firebender.blue: Your Fire Breath burns blue, hits forty percent harder and burns longer.
Your Fire Circle burns blue, hits forty percent harder and burns longer.
Your Fire Jump and Fire Jet burn blue, hit forty percent harder and burn longer.
Your Fire Wall burns blue, hits forty percent harder and burns longer.
Only a master's flame burns hot enough to turn blue. Your Fire Punch turns blue, hits forty percent harder and burns longer. Blue fire is mastery, not a sub-bending.
Spin up a tornado of blue fire that stays where it forms. Learn every other blue fire skill first. This completes blue fire and turns your emblem blue.
skill.elemental_bendings.firebender.comb: Blast Jump replaces Fire Jump and Fire Jet: ride a controlled blast through the air.
Learn every other combustionbending skill first. Hold Combustion Blast to charge it, and you take on the combustion stances and emblem.
A heavy blast that scatters five burning embers.
Combustion Barrage replaces Fire Breath: four quick, smaller blasts.
Delayed Detonation replaces Fire Wall: a blast that sticks where it lands and goes off harder.
Open your third eye. Combustion Blast replaces Fire Punch, and more combustionbending skills replace your other fire moves.
Explosive Repulsion replaces Fire Circle: a blast around you that throws everything back.
Blast the ground into a cloud of smoke that blinds everyone near you.
skill.elemental_bendings.firebender.drag: Learn firebending the way the first firebenders did, from the dragons. Your Fire Punch shimmers with the dragons' colors, hits forty percent harder and burns longer. Dragon fire is a sub-bending of its own.
Your Fire Breath shimmers with every color of the dragons' flame, hits forty percent harder and burns longer.
Your Fire Circle shimmers with every color of the dragons' flame, hits forty percent harder and burns longer.
Your Fire Jump and Fire Jet shimmer with every color of the dragons' flame, hit forty percent harder and burn longer.
Your Fire Wall shimmers with every color of the dragons' flame, hits forty percent harder and burns longer.
Spin up a vortex of dragon fire with two dragons coiled around it. Learn every other dragon fire skill first. This completes dragon fire and gives you its emblem.
skill.elemental_bendings.firebender.ligh: Chain Lightning replaces Fire Circle: a bolt that leaps from creature to creature.
Lightning Bolt replaces Fire Punch, and more lightningbending skills replace your other fire moves. Rain can't douse lightning.
Flash Step replaces Fire Jump and Fire Jet: vanish and reappear up to twelve blocks away.
Catch lightning and send it back out. Right after your strike lands, Lightning Bolt redirects it.
Learn every other lightningbending skill first. Lightning Strike becomes a storm, and you take on the lightning stances and emblem.
Lightning Stream replaces Fire Breath: a crackling stream of lightning for as long as you hold it.
Call lightning down from the sky onto the spot you look at.
Thunderclap replaces Fire Wall: a cone of lightning that throws back everything in front of you.
skill.elemental_bendings.waterbender.blo: Bend the blood in your own body to lift yourself into the air for a few seconds at night.
Blood Puppetry replaces Water Glide: work a creature like a puppet.
Blood Whip replaces Water Whip at night: a whip of blood that heals you as it cuts.
Bend the blood inside living creatures. At night you draw, blast and clot blood in place of water.
Levitation replaces Water Shield at night: lift every creature in front of you into the air.
Learn every other bloodbending skill first. Bloodbend at any hour, and take on the bloodbending stances and emblem.
Pour blood into a creature to heal it, or drink it to heal yourself.
skill.elemental_bendings.waterbender.ice: Deep Freeze replaces Freeze and Thaw: ice becomes packed ice, and spears and shards hit harder.
Freeze water the instant you bend it. Draw Ice replaces Pick Up Water, and more icebending skills replace your other water moves.
Ice Blast replaces Water Blast: a jagged block of ice that freezes what it hits.
Learn every other icebending skill first. Encase a creature in ice, and take on the icebending stances and emblem.
Ice Shield replaces Water Shield: a dome of ice that freezes attackers.
Freeze your shoes and skate across any ground whenever you sprint.
Ice Whip replaces Water Whip: a lash of jagged ice.
skill.elemental_bendings.waterbender.pla: Learn every other plantbending skill first. Raise a field of thorned brambles where you look, and take on the plantbending stances and emblem.
Bend the water inside living plants. You draw sap from leaves and grass in place of water, and blast, condense and throw it.
Pull the plants around you into a towering golem and fight from inside it.
Root Glide replaces Water Glide: plants carry you across water, and Nether roots across lava.
Hide coils of vines in the ground that bind whoever steps on them.
Burst pollen and spores that daze everyone near them.
Vine Snare replaces Water Shield: vines that bind every creature in front of you.
Vine Whip replaces Water Whip: a thorned vine that drags what it hits toward you.
Every 4 creatures you defeat earn a mastery point. Spend them on vacuumbending, soundbending or spiritual airbending. Its last skill completes a path.
skill_tree.elemental_bendings.earthbende: Every 4 creatures you defeat earn a mastery point. A path changes your earth moves one skill at a time, and its last skill completes it.
skill_tree.elemental_bendings.firebender: Every 4 creatures you defeat earn a mastery point. A path changes your fire moves one skill at a time, and its last skill completes it.
skill_tree.elemental_bendings.waterbende: Every 4 creatures you defeat earn a mastery point. Spend them on bloodbending, plantbending or icebending.
